description: Default providers, in the order they are tried, from the end-to-end check on 2026-11-05 (search, title match, stream and real video bytes for Inception, Interstellar, Jawan and Pathaan). internetArchive is last: it only has public-domain and Creative Commons films (verified on Night of the Living Dead, Nosferatu, The General, His Girl Friday and Charade). vega and luxMovies refuse data-centre IPs, so hosted servers may narrow this list with ENABLED_PROVIDERS.
disabledByDefaultReason: Not verified for browser playback in the current live checks.
streamSourcesDescription: Playback sources tried together, in ranking order (STREAM_SOURCES in .env overrides it). desiflix is a Stremio add-on API; moviebox, pengu, flix_emby and flix_other are Doom-addon providers in backend/vendor/doom-addon (pengu and the flix ones only run with your own link in .env); the rest are vega-style providers from defaultProviders and also need ENABLED_PROVIDERS. vega and luxMovies refuse data-centre IPs, so they stay out of the server list but work on a PC.
